query: Do all CPF Investment Scheme (CPFIS)-included Unit Trusts/ILP sub-funds charge trailer fees?
reference_answer: Trailer fees is subjected to the business agreements between product providers and their distributors (including financial advisors). Some funds may not have trailer fees payable to distributors.
answer: Based on the available information, not all CPFIS-included Unit Trusts/ILP sub-funds charge trailer fees. Some may include them while others do not. [Document N]
